title: Resetting the high scores
description: The high scores room, with a gold trophy beside each record and the four doors they unlock. The player pushes a block along the floor; past the middle a warning reads THIS WILL CLEAR EVERYTHING!, and when the block covers the button at the end, the trophies and doors vanish, the screen shakes and every record reads 0.
